entities.summary: Kimberly Kaye Wyatt is an American singer, dancer, actress, and television personality. She is a member of the girl group and dance ensemble the Pussycat Dolls; she was also formerly half of pop duo Her Majesty & the Wolves (2010–2014). Her acting roles include Siyotanka in the American comedy series Poor Paul (2009–2011) and Sasha in the British musical drama series Almost Never (2019–2021).
